# Document host-test fixtures

Real files (extensions are the format under test). Regenerated by `python3 gen_fixtures.py`. Do not rewrite `tiny-comic.cbr` (no RAR writer on CI).

| File | What |
|------|------|
| `mixed.epub` | Two markup chapters + `linear="no"` nav + decorative img + scan spine item |
| `text-only.epub` | Markup only → `ERR_DOC_NO_IMAGES` |
| `drm.epub` | AES `encryption.xml` on chapter XHTML → `ERR_DOC_DRM` |
| `font-embed.epub` | Font obfuscation only → still extracts |
| `north-wind.fb2` | Two text sections (title/epigraph/poem) + image-only plate |
| `north-wind.fbz` | Same FB2 inside a zip |
| `comic.cbz` | `page2.png` / `page10.png` (+ hidden/ComicInfo) natural-sort |
| `tiny-comic.cbr` | Store-only RAR3, same page names as the CBZ |
| `tiny.mobi` | MOBI6, two markup chapters + `recindex` plate |
| `tiny.azw3` | Same story, MOBI `version = 8`, no images |
| `palmdoc.mobi` | PalmDOC compression 2 |
| `drm.mobi` | Encryption type 2 → `ERR_DOC_DRM` |
| `print-replica.azw4` | `mobiType` 258 → `ERR_DOC_UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT` |
| `audio.mobi` | `mobiType` 4 |
| `dictionary.mobi` | EXTH 403 dictionary |
| `fdst.azw3` | KF8 FDST two HTML flows |
| `kf8-skel.azw3` | KF8 SKEL/FRAG reconstruction |
| `palmdoc.pdb` | `TEXtREAd` PalmDOC |
| `truncated.cbr` | RAR3 magic only → `ERR_DOC_OPEN_FAILED` |
| `not-a-book.pdf` / `not-a-book.html` | Sniff-and-reject |
| `garbage.bin` | Unrecognized bytes |

Markup books are a short self-authored retelling of *The North Wind and the Sun* (not a publisher dump).
